title: Optimal-order distinct distances in every dimension at least three
exact_target: For each fixed integer $d>=3$, does there exist $c_d>0$ such that every set of $n>=2$ distinct points in $R^d$ determines at least $c_d$ $n^{2/d}$ different Euclidean distances?
